text: Year 13475. A landmass of 3677 cells centred near (231,289) has no animals on it and 586 harvestable biomass going ungrazed, while 290 animals are alive on 2 other landmass(es) they cannot leave. That is how three worlds died: an island herd winks out, the island becomes the world's larder, and everyone else starves on overgrazed ground across water too deep to walk. Sending 40 founders copied whole from living animals, brains included. -- tools/island_watch.py
